user.title: Add a ceiling fan
user.description: Give the fan a name, e.g. Kitchen.

ready.title: Find the remote
ready.description: Stand 1-3 feet from the controller. Press and HOLD any button on the remote, keep holding it, and then start the search. The search takes up to about 35 seconds - keep the button held the whole time.

menu_options.identify: Start the search - I'm holding a button now
menu_options.frequency: Skip the search - I'll pick the frequency myself
menu_options.preset_manual: Skip the search - enter a DIP switch code

frequency.title: Remote frequency
frequency.description: Pick the frequency if you know it (the FCC ID on the back of the remote can be looked up), or let the bridge search for it.

scan_failed.title: No signal found
scan_failed.description: Nothing was heard on any common frequency. Hold the remote 1-3 feet from the controller and keep pressing a button for the whole scan. Infrared (point-at-the-fan) remotes cannot be learned.

button.title: Learn the remote
button.description:
Frequency: {frequency} MHz. Learned so far: {learned}.

Choose Ready, then press and HOLD **{button}** on the remote for about 2 seconds, 1-3 feet from the controller. Skip any button your remote doesn't have.

menu_options.capture: Ready - I'll hold the button now

capture_failed.title: Button not learned
capture_failed.description:
{reason}

Try again holding the button a full 2 seconds, 1-3 feet from the controller.

identify_failed.title: No remote detected
identify_failed.description: Nothing was heard on any common frequency. Hold the remote 1-3 feet from the controller and keep pressing a button for the whole search. Infrared (point-at-the-fan) remotes cannot be learned.

menu_options.ready: Try again - hold the button before starting
menu_options.preset_manual: Enter a DIP switch code instead

preset_manual.title: DIP switch code
preset_manual.description: For Chungear E01BT-S remotes: pick the fan's 4-bit DIP switch code.

extras.title: Custom buttons
extras.description: The standard keys are done. You can add extra buttons for anything else on the remote - a breeze mode, a timer, a nightlight. Added so far: {added}.

add_custom.title: Name the button
add_custom.description: What should this button be called? Use the name on the remote, for example Breeze, Timer, or Nightlight.

custom_failed.title: Button not learned
custom_failed.description:
{reason}

Try again holding the button a full 2 seconds, 1-3 feet from the controller.

progress.identifying: Press and HOLD a button on the remote now, 1-3 feet from the controller, and keep holding until this finishes.
progress.scanning: Searching common frequencies. Keep pressing and holding any button on the remote, 1-3 feet from the controller.
progress.hold_button: Press and HOLD {button} on the remote now, for about 2 seconds.

abort.no_bridge: No RF bridge found. Make sure the ESPHome Ceiling Fan Controller is online and running the bridge firmware.
abort.nothing_learned: No buttons were learned, so nothing was added.
abort.already_configured: This remote is already set up as "{other}". If two fans answer to the same remote, change one remote's code (DIP switches) and its fan receiver, then add it again.

options.scan: I don't know - find it for me
